items.correction: Use exact repository paths docs/status.md, docs/roadmap.md, docs/version-history.md, and docs/devlog.md. The corrected successor returned the authoritative BASELINE-0033 records.

items.operation: Summarize environment, retained evidence identities, and fresh-run document-count distributions
items.failure: The first summary used integer keys in PowerShell hashtables and ConvertTo-Json rejected the dictionary as unsupported.
items.correction: Initialize ordered string-key dictionaries for counts zero through four. The corrected successor returned all identities, distributions, and environment facts.

items.operation: Validate the initial BASELINE-0034 governed milestone projection
items.failure: The first draft used active for UNIT-002 and pending for later units. The governed validator accepts in_progress and planned for those states and returned four invalid-status errors.
items.correction: Change only UNIT-002 to in_progress and UNIT-003 through UNIT-005 to planned, preserving every purpose, dependency, authority, scope, gate, and exit condition. Use only a clean successor validation as positive evidence.

items.failure: The first ripgrep command passed artifacts/verification/baseline-0033-*.json as a literal Windows path and ripgrep rejected the invalid wildcard path.
items.correction: Use an explicit artifacts/verification root with --glob baseline-0033-*.json. The corrected successor returned the historical validator evidence references.

items.operation: Run the predecessor 42-script validator inventory using each script's default invocation
items.failure: The aggregate suppressed child output and had no terminal summary after two minutes. Its first item was mutating verify_baseline.py, which completed far enough to create and promote a fresh passing BASELINE-0033 attempt before the outer aggregate was interrupted; completed count and current child remained unknown.
items.correction: Move all three generated files intact to exact external verification custody, restore artifacts/evaluations/latest.json from its byte-identical tracked twin baseline-0033-attempt-002.json, and prove the latest pointer has no Git diff. Use only explicit current-phase read-only validators with declared inputs and observable terminal results.

items.operation: Inspect validator command help before selecting current-phase invocations
items.failure: verify_baseline.py has no argument parser, so passing --help started its mutating orchestration instead of returning usage. A bounded output pipeline terminated the probe before it created an evaluation; no second untracked attempt existed.
items.correction: Inspect the script source before invocation, classify it as a mutating baseline builder rather than a side-effect-free validator, and exclude it from preimplementation static validation.

items.operation: Verify the pushed BASELINE-0034 freeze against its configured upstream
items.failure: The first push created the public branch, but the local origin remote fetched only main, so @{upstream} did not resolve and could not supply tracking evidence.
items.external_effect: The intended public branch was created at b45cdea83a7eac6c1488a25d6a7d34254e75f44a; no other ref changed.
items.correction: Fetch the exact branch into an explicit remote-tracking ref, add only that exact fetch mapping to origin, set the branch upstream, and require local, tracking, ls-remote, and anonymous ref identities to agree.

items.operation: Populate the exact BASELINE-0034 remote-tracking ref
items.failure: The first PowerShell double-quoted refspec interpreted $branch:refs as a scoped variable and produced an invalid refs/heads//remotes/... refspec.
items.correction: Use an explicitly braced branch variable in the exact refspec. The corrected fetch created origin/codex/baseline-0034-retrieval-tier-cap-latency at the intended commit.

items.operation: Bind the local BASELINE-0034 branch to the exact remote-tracking branch
items.failure: After the explicit fetch created the tracking ref, git branch --set-upstream-to still refused it because origin's configured fetch specification covered only main.
items.correction: Add the single exact BASELINE-0034 branch fetch specification, then set upstream. Local HEAD, tracking HEAD, ls-remote, and anonymous GitHub ref all resolve to b45cdea83a7eac6c1488a25d6a7d34254e75f44a.

items.operation: Count GitHub deployments while confirming the freeze did not deploy
items.failure: The first wrapper applied @(...).Count to a wrapped empty API result and reported one object rather than zero deployments.
items.correction: Inspect the raw GitHub API response and parse its JSON array directly. HTTP 200 returned the exact two-byte body [] and the corrected deployment count is zero.

items.failure: The first compact validation command guessed a repository-local scripts/verify_milestone.py path that does not exist and Python exited before milestone validation.
